verdict.rationale: Docs mention Git workflow integration (droid-cli operates from your Git workflow), a GitHub integration filter in Software Factory, and a 'review the diff, and merge' flow implying PR-based delivery, but there is no explicit walkthrough of connecting a GitHub repo or agent-initiated PR creation mechanics. missing for 10: dedicated GitHub repo-connection docs, explicit PR-opening API/CLI command, and independent confirmation of PR creation working end-to-end.
